subject: general
question: In August 2021, the Reserve Bank of India announced an increase in limit for fund transfer to Nepal under the ‘Indo-Nepal Remittance Facility Scheme’ to ______ per transaction w.e.f. 1 October 2021.
solution:
The correct answer is __**₹2 lakhs.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The Reserve Bank of India has made enhancements to the Indo-Nepal Remittance Facility Scheme.
 
• The ceiling per transaction has been increased four-fold to ₹2 lakh and the cap of 12 remittances in a year per remitter has been removed.
 
• The enhancements have been announced to boost trade payments between the two countries.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Under the scheme, the beneficiary receives funds in Nepalese Rupees through credit to her / his bank account maintained with the subsidiary of State Bank of India in Nepal, — Nepal SBI Bank Limited (NSBL) or through an agency arrangement.
 
• The central bank asked banks to put in place suitable velocity checks and other risk mitigation procedures.
 
• ​RBI:
 
 
• Governor - Shaktikanta Das.
 
• Headquarters - Mumbai.
 
• Founded: 1 April 1935, Kolkata.
